svg.title: Use Case: Write a Certificate Slot and Refresh Trust Stores

g.text: Use Case: Write a Certificate Slot and Refresh Trust Stores
discard the CRL of the previous certificate
invalidate certificate and CRL cache entries,
disable member and persist state if fingerprint differs
Planned: SaveCertificateWithCrl, CRL propagation from the source
CRL taken from the source (session CRL or source slot). Same
notification path as a CRL import: see "Import a CRL".
The notification is part of the service operation, not a separate step
for the caller. A denied write does not notify. A failed backend write still
notifies, because the stored content may have changed. A slot written outside
